title: Using Service Bus with Azure Functions
description: Connect Azure Service Bus queues and topics to Azure Functions for serverless message processing.

data.text: Azure Functions can be triggered by Service Bus messages out of the box. You do not need to manage a receiver loop or connection lifecycle -- the Functions runtime handles scaling, message locking, and completion for you.

data.title: Avoid Long-Running Functions
data.text: If your function takes longer than the Service Bus lock duration (default 30 seconds), renew the lock or disable auto-complete and complete manually.

data.title: Create a Service Bus-Triggered Function
data.description: Build a function that processes inventory updates from a Service Bus queue.
steps: Create a new Azure Functions project in C# or JavaScript.
Add a Service Bus trigger for the inventory-updates queue.
Log the message body and update a local in-memory inventory store.
Configure host.json with a prefetch count of 50.
data.expectedOutcome: A deployable function that triggers on new inventory messages and logs them.
